description: Food, household upgrades and practical machines drive the 2019–2020 run, with pancakes, flight, popcorn, a new kitchen, a car wash, harvesting, a trail camera, garage doors, pizza, bread, ice, barbecue and pneumatic delivery all receiving the full Pat and Mat treatment.

s14e01.description: Pat and Mat decide to make pancakes alongside the rest of dinner, and the apparently simple batter-and-pan routine expands into another kitchen production line.

s14e02.description: The desire to fly returns in mechanical form as Pat and Mat build a homemade flying machine, testing whether ordinary materials and stubborn optimism can produce actual lift.

s14e03.description: Pat and Mat want popcorn and reject the obvious saucepan method in favor of a purpose-built arrangement of pots, funnels and foil that turns snack preparation into engineering.

s14e04.description: A worn-out kitchen needs new furniture, so Pat and Mat assemble replacement cabinets and discover that flat-pack geometry becomes much more flexible when instructions are treated as suggestions.

s14e05.description: Rather than wash the car normally, Pat and Mat build their own reusable car wash, creating a machine whose brushes, water and moving parts require almost as much maintenance as the vehicle.

s14e06.description: Harvest time leaves Pat and Mat with a large crop of apples to gather, crush and press, prompting them to mechanize each stage of turning the fruit into juice.

s14e07.description: When apples begin disappearing, Pat and Mat set up a trail camera and improvised trap system to identify the visitor without having to stand guard over the garden themselves.

s14e08.description: A garage door that will not stay open makes parking unnecessarily difficult, so Pat and Mat redesign the mechanism to create an entrance that should respond on command.

s14e09.description: After losing the pizza they expected to eat, Pat and Mat decide to make one themselves, only to discover that preparing the food is easier than providing an oven large enough for their ambitions.

s14e10.description: Unacceptably tough bread convinces Pat and Mat to bake a fresh loaf, turning kneading, proving and baking into a domestic production process sized according to their appetite rather than common sense.

s14e11.description: Hot weather creates an urgent need for ice, so Pat and Mat set up their own ice-making process and discover that keeping frozen water frozen is a separate engineering problem.

s14e12.description: A barbecue refuses to heat properly, and Pat and Mat keep escalating their fire-starting methods until cooking outdoors becomes a practical lesson in why combustion deserves respect.

s14e13.description: Repeatedly carrying things between two points irritates Pat and Mat enough to inspire a pneumatic tube system, replacing a short walk with an elaborate network designed to move objects by air.
